reply_text:
One merge blocker:

*High — paid plans reject every nonempty upload* (`src/plans.js:11`). `entry.quotaKiB << 10` uses JavaScript’s signed 32-bit bitwise arithmetic, so both `team` (200 GiB) and `archive` (2 TiB) convert to *0 bytes*. I reproduced a 1-byte upload being rejected on an empty account for each plan.

Use multiplication by `1024` instead, and add quota-conversion and upload tests for both paid plans before merging.

All 4 existing tests pass, but they miss this. No code changed.
